summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new /planner deterministic trip planner. All 6 wizard steps, validation logic, result rendering (green/yellow scenario), impossible-scenario (red) viability, advisor notices, Leaflet map, day-by-day timeline, included/excluded chips, compatible-trips list, FromPrice, CTA links (planTrip prefill + trip detail), Home CTA, side-menu link, trilingual variants (/en/trip-planner, /fr/planificateur), and mobile responsiveness all verified via Playwright DOM assertions. Engine recommended only existing XALUCA_TRIPS routeIds in both scenarios (no invented routes).
critical_code_review_comments: PlannerPage.jsx step-dot disabling logic uses `i > step && !valid.slice(0, i).every(Boolean)` which correctly allows going back to visited steps. Works as intended.
PlannerResult.jsx is ~280 lines and well-modularized; no DRY issues observed.

Engine deterministically picks from XALUCA_TRIPS — verified for both green and red scenarios (cta-view hrefs are real existing trip detail pages: programa_7n_8d for 8 days, programa_6n_7d for 4-day impossible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All planner feature flows pass on desktop and mobile. Green scenario (Marrakech→Fez, 8d, 4 dests, equilibrado): viability=Excelente, top-score=100%, 8 timeline rows, 5 compatible trips, map renders, CTAs link to /planifica-tu-viaje?trip=tourMarrakechFez78 and /viajes/gransur/marrakech_fez/programa_7n_8d. Red scenario (4d impossible): viability=No recomendado, 79% top score (still an existing XALUCA trip programa_6n_7d), 4 advisor notices including a 'more comfortable in N days' notice. Home CTA (home-planner-cta-button) and side-menu 'Planificador inteligente' both navigate to /planner. Trilingual /en/trip-planner and /fr/planificateur load with translated UI (Step/Étape verified). Mobile 390px viewport renders without overlap.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — all assertions passed.
